Name: Handsome Sam
Author: LydiaStriker
Description:
I never liked Sam's hair and not too many people know how to rock the 'do well, so I decided to make a more portrait accurate hairstyle. What started off with a simple hairstyle, ended up with a few tweaks here and there and now my boy is rocking his collar as he should be. Ironically works well with DCBurger's Sam portrait, too.

I had to redraw several frames and am not sure if it's overly accurate to vanilla Sam's sprite, but if there are any issues with the sprite, let me know. I'm not at all a pixel artist, but I just felt like giving back to the modding community and I adore this game, too.

Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: It occurred to me years later that I forgot to update the manifest.json file in my old download! I'm very sorry for that. Here's the updated version (for real this time!)

Manifest.Name: LydiaStriker's Handsome Sam
Manifest.Description: Replaces the ugly vanilla Sam sprite with a better-looking one!
